releaseNotes.title: New branch structure
releaseNotes.body: X-Menu is moving to Stable Basic, Stable Advanced, Stable Special Access, Tester, Development 1, Development 2 and Development Integration. Stable Basic starts with Nickname Changer. Tester will keep the current tested feature set while unified Main/Alpha support is developed.

announcement.title: Branch migration in progress
announcement.message: The new branch structure is being prepared. Existing working builds remain preserved for rollback until the replacement branches are validated.

launcher.message: Launcher v0.7.7 prepares the new branch structure and revalidates channel access before each action.
